actions.name: Conduct Telephony Denial of Service (TDoS) attack
actions.description: An attempt to make a telephone system unavailable to the intended user(s) by preventing incoming and/or outgoing calls, using distraction calls to overwhelm the victim’s telephone system.

actions.name: Use automated software applications to conduct TDoS attack
actions.description: Use software applications to make tens or hundreds of calls simultaneously or in rapid succession, including VOIP and SIP calls, with spoofed numbers and call attributes.

actions.name: Use manual social network campaigns to conduct TDoS attack
actions.description: Use social networks to encourage individuals to flood a particular number with a calling campaign.

relations.rationale: TDoS attacks have evolved from manual to automated
